primary.description: Emerald Green - Used for Primary CTAs, PIX, and positive yields. Represents money and growth.

background.description: Clean, airy whites and very soft grays to maximize readability and trust.

typography.heading_font: Manrope (or default native System bold if custom fonts aren't setup, but simulate a geometric sans style)

Button.primary: bg-[#10B981] active:bg-[#047857] rounded-xl py-4 flex flex-row justify-center items-center shadow-md
Button.secondary: bg-[#F3F4F6] active:bg-[#E5E7EB] rounded-xl py-4 flex flex-row justify-center items-center

Card.base: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#E5E7EB] shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] p-5 mb-4

Input.base: bg-[#F9FAFB] border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-[#111827] text-base focus:border-[#10B981]

Auth.description: Login/Register screens. Clean white background, prominent logo, highly trusted inputs. No social logins required for MVP. Only Email/Password.

HomeDashboard.description: Main screen. Generous spacing at the top. Shows 'Saldo na carteira' and 'Rendimentos acumulados'. Below: 'Meus Lotes Ativos' showing a list/carousel. Each active lote must have a progress bar indicating days passed vs 30 days total, and the current generated yield.
HomeDashboard.mechanics: The yield is hourly. Visually emphasize that money is growing.

Loja.description: Catalog of available lotes. Display cards with a high-quality photo, Name, Price, Rendimento/hora, and a 'Comprar' button. Cards should feel like premium product listings.

LoteDetail.description: Detail modal/screen. Big image at the top. Clear breakdown of financials (e.g. Custa R$ 30, Rende R$ 0,09/h, Rende R$ 64,80 em 30 dias). Bold CTA to buy. Debits directly from the user's available balance.

Carteira.description: Wallet view. Big display of 'Saldo Disponível' and 'Lucros Acumulados'. Buttons: 'Depositar via PIX', 'Sacar'. Below: Historico de transações (deposits, purchases, hourly credits, withdrawals).

Deposit.description: User enters amount. Screen displays a fake PIX QR code and a 'Chave PIX' (copyable). CTA 'Já paguei'. Clicking it creates a pending deposit request for the admin.

Withdraw.description: User enters amount and their PIX key to receive funds. Checks against balance. Creates a pending withdrawal request.

Profile.description: Simple profile options, 'Licença e Empresa' link, and Logout button. A hidden tap gesture (e.g. tap 5 times on version number) or a specific admin login routes to the Admin Panel.

AboutLicense.description: Corporate trust page. Shows a photo of a modern building, text about 'LotePro Investimentos', mission, and a fictional CNPJ (e.g., 45.123.456/0001-90). Emphasize security and seriousness.

AdminPanel.description: Hidden route. Tabs/Sections for: 1. Aprovar Depósitos (list of pending + approve/reject). 2. Aprovar Saques. 3. Gerenciar Lotes (CRUD for name, price, hourly yield, duration, photo URL). 4. Listar Usuários (view balances). 5. Configurar Chave PIX da empresa.

lote_tech_pc.description: Premium tech computer workstation. Use for the 'Lote de PC' product.

lote_safe_box.description: Silver safe box. Use for a high-yield 'Cofre' lote.

lote_gold.description: Stack of gold coins. Use for a premium 'Ouro' lote.

corporate_building.description: Modern corporate building. Use for the Sobre/Licença page.

pix_qr_placeholder.description: Generic QR code placeholder for the deposit PIX screen.

rules: All interactive elements (TouchableOpacity, Pressable, Button, TextInput) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use plain `.js` files for React Native Expo components, NOT `.tsx` as per the user's explicit instructions.
Use Nativewind for styling if available, otherwise translate the provided Tailwind classes strictly into standard React Native StyleSheet objects.
For the bottom navigation, use @react-navigation/bottom-tabs. For icons, strictly use @expo/vector-icons (Feather or Ionicons are recommended).
Never use placeholders like 'via.placeholder.com' - strictly use the URLs provided in the `media` section.

Ensure 'trust' elements are heavily visible: borders should be crisp, text contrasts very high, and the Emerald Green (#10B981) should be used carefully for calls-to-action to give it an official banking feel.
The application logic will require a state manager (e.g., Context API or Zustand) to handle user balance, pending transactions, and the real-time hourly yield calculation.

Store the timestamp of when a Lote was bought, and dynamically calculate the yield based on `(current_time - bought_time) * hourly_yield` up to 30 days. You can use a `setInterval` in the UI to give a 'live increment' visual effect to the user's earnings, enhancing the 'dopamine/trust' hit.
Admin routes must be completely isolated from the standard BottomTab navigator.
